initial_simplification: Mice are very important in neuroscience research because they help scientists understand how the brain works. Researchers can easily control and study them. For a long time, scientists have preferred to use male mice in experiments. One reason for this is that female mice have hormone cycles that can change their behavior, which might affect the results of the studies.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice have been very important for research on how the brain works. Scientists can easily study and control mice to learn more about the brain's complex functions. Traditionally, researchers have chosen male mice for experiments instead of female mice. This choice is partly because female mice experience changes in hormones that can affect their behavior, which might lead to inconsistent results in studies.
